original_test_intent: Verify the Manufacturer field of the intended SMBIOS Type 3 System Chassis record exactly matches the approved enclosure manufacturer and remains correct after reboot, independently of Type 1 system and Type 2 board manufacturers.
original_method: Archive every Type 3 structure, bind the physical enclosure to the target record using chassis serial/asset/type/BOM identity, compare its Manufacturer under the approved normalization policy, reboot and repeat against the same chassis identity.
manual_activity: A user supplies and approves the chassis identity/reference and reboot plan. Record-scoped collection and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Chassis serial/asset/type/BOM mapping to the target Type 3 record
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only and preserve all Type 3 structures plus errors.
Do not substitute Type 1 or Type 2 Manufacturer or assume the first Type 3 record.
Reject blank, placeholder, wrong-enclosure and unapproved vendor-alias values.
Protect correlated chassis serial/asset identifiers in evidence.
Stop on record ambiguity, identity drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 3/tool/BOM evidence, identify the intended enclosure record and compare its Manufacturer before and after reboot.
Do not modify DMI, reveal protected identity fields unnecessarily or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the target enclosure mapping, exact manufacturer and normalization rules.
Resolve vendor-brand versus OEM-manufacturer differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Type 3 scope is relevant, but grep loses multi-record identity and neighboring context, hides errors and uses insecure transport assumptions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive unfiltered Type 3 output with tool version/errors, bind the target using correlated chassis identity fields and extract only that record's Manufacturer.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 3 Manufacturer scope, linked chassis script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate each Type 3 record with chassis serial, asset, type and approved BOM, then compare the selected record's normalized Manufacturer while retaining the raw string and same-record provenance across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 3 systems, including platforms with more than one enclosure record.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved enclosure/BOM identity recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact enclosure-record selection and vendor-string normalization without changing the source field.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Target enclosure mapping and expected manufacturer.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM, brand and legal manufacturer strings may differ; only an approved mapping can define equivalence.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a vendor alias or supported placeholder only for a specifically identified enclosure/BOM and must preserve the raw Type 3 value.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected chassis Manufacturer, enclosure/BOM mapping and tool version
Raw pre-reboot all-Type-3 records plus selected Manufacturer comparison
Approved reboot and host/management health evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Type 3 script and persistence criterion consistently target the chassis Manufacturer field.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field and safe read method are clear; the exact manufacturer and enclosure mapping are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps Type 3 collection but adds enclosure identity, full evidence and visible errors.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains field separation and recovery while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds multi-enclosure handling, identifier protection and explicit OEM/brand normalization governance.

review_improvement: Prevents a Manufacturer from the system, baseboard or wrong enclosure record from satisfying the chassis-specific case.
independent_technical_reasoning: After reference and mapping approval, all core read, compare and reboot operations are software-controlled; an engineer's later verdict does not make the case partial.
